content.title: Snow-Cliff Climb | Grip Detail, Recoverable Slip and Continued Ascent
content.summary: An adult ice rescuer loses one foothold, recovers three-point contact and continues upward. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult climber, route, rope and wall persist. + Every move is supported by visible hand or foot contact. + Only one bounded slip occurs and the rope catches it. + Recovery restores a countable three-point stance. + The final upward action follows proven stabilization.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult rescue climber on a blue-ice wall with one red rope, one harness and a weather mast above. Break the left ice shelf once; the body drops less than one body length and the red rope becomes visibly taut. End with the adult climber breathing once, looking toward the weather mast and advancing one controlled step upward.
required_anchors: One clearly adult climber, route, rope and wall persist.
Every move is supported by visible hand or foot contact.
Recovery restores a countable three-point stance.
The final upward action follows proven stabilization.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult ice rescuer loses one foothold, recovers three-point contact and continues upward. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用近身手部、靴底、冰雪与绳索受力持续证明同一攀登路线；成年人物在一次支点滑脱后由绳索和另一只手恢复，不瞬移、不切换山体，最后重新站稳并确认上方路线。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult climber, route, rope and wall persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult climber, route, rope and wall persist."

invariants.rule: Every move is supported by visible hand or foot contact.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every move is supported by visible hand or foot contact."

invariants.rule: Only one bounded slip occurs and the rope catches it.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Only one bounded slip occurs and the rope catches it."

invariants.rule: Recovery restores a countable three-point stance.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Recovery restores a countable three-point stance."

invariants.rule: The final upward action follows proven stabilization.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final upward action follows proven stabilization."

slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers

the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
